title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face, which consists of a single loop. In this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0312, 0.0312) with a radius of 0.0312 units. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0625 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size accordingly. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it according to the Euler angles and translating it based on the translation vector defined in the coordinate system. Extrude the transformed two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Integrate this newly created part as a separate solid body within the existing assembly. The final dimensions of the part are 0.0625 units in length, 0.0625 units in width, and 0.7500000000000001 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0312, 0.0312)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0312)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = (
    sketch
    .extrude(0.75)  # Extrude the sketch along the Z-axis
)

# The final model
r = cylinder

# Display the model
